Ben jij een technisch talent met een passie voor machinebouw en constructies? Wil jij werken aan innovatieve technische oplossingen en jouw ontwerpen werkelijkheid zien worden? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als Mechanical Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van klantwensen en functionele specificaties naar innovatieve, praktische en produceerbare mechanische oplossingen. Je verdiept je in de technische vraagstukken van de klant en werkt deze uit tot doordachte ontwerpen van mechanische systemen en constructies. Daarbij houd je continu rekening met functionaliteit, maakbaarheid, kwaliteit en de eisen die aan het eindproduct worden gesteld.

Vanuit jouw ontwerpen ontwikkel en beheer je de complete technische documentatie. Je werkt gedetailleerde 3D-modellen uit en stelt de benodigde GA-, detail- en productietekeningen op. Dankzij jouw nauwkeurige engineering beschikken productie en montage over de juiste informatie om projecten efficiënt en volgens planning te realiseren.

Gedurende het gehele ontwerpproces bewaak je de technische kwaliteit van jouw oplossingen. jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**Intro**

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

  
  

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.

  
  

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

  
  

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help earth benefit from space?

  
  

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact. We are looking for a dedicated professional who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Specific Qualification requirements**

* **Master's degree** in **Mechanical Engineering**, **Aerospace Engineering**, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 years** of relevant professional **experience** in **mechanical design** and **engineering**, preferably within the **aerospace**, **space**, or **testing industry**.
* Proven experience in the **design** and **development** of **mechanical structures**, **fixtures**, **Mechanical Ground Support Equipment (MGSE)**, or specialized testing equipment.
* Proficiency in **3D CAD modelling** and **mechanical design**, preferably using **3DEXPERIENC****E (3DX)**.
* Hands-on experience with **Finite Element Analysis (FEA)** and **structural analysis**, preferably using **MSC Nastran/Patran**.
* Good knowledge of **mechanical design principles**, **structural integrity**, **materials**, **manufacturing processes**, and **engineering tolerances.**
* Experience preparing **manufacturing drawings**, **design justification files**, **engineering calculations**, and technical documentation.
* Familiarity with **mechanical equipment installation**, **integration**, and **verification** activities, including **proof load** and **acceptance testing**.
* Good command of **English**, both written and spoken.

**Legal and Security Requirements**

* **Only European Union (EU) citizens can be employed by SSC Space Netherlands for this specific position.**
* Applicants are required to provide a copy of their passport and degree certificate. SSC Space Netherlands will validate the Degree with the issuing University and provide evidence to ESA.
* Prior to issuing a letter of employment the applicant shall provide to SSC Space Netherlands a recent official document declaring that they are of good conduct from the country where currently resident.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Specific Tasks**
  
The Service Provider shall:

* Create MGSE design to be used to support tests in the Test Centre and in the ESTEC laboratories. The design is meant to be ready for manufacturing either in the electromechanical workshop of the Engineering Services Section, or by an organisation that is not part of ESA.
* If the design will be manufactured by an organisation that is not part of ESA, then the Service Provider shall create manufacturing drawings. As part of this design task, the Service Provider shall perform all required numerical analysis and report it in the design justification file.
* The tools to use are the ones made available as a Customer Furnished Item (CFI) by ESA: 3DX for mechanical design, Nastran/Patran for Finite element modelling and analysis.
* Install the MGSE the Service has designed only when requested to do so by ESA. This installation includes supervision and/or execution of any required tests (e.g. proof load testing, acceptance testing).

**Benefits**
------------

**Contract**

* The selected candidate will receive good remuneration in line with ESA Job Class.
* Will be registered for both social security and tax in the Netherlands.
* The standard working hours are 40 per week. There are 12 public holidays and an additional 30 annual days holiday.
* Training to improve efficiency and provide strength for future career are of course included.
* SSC Space Netherlands assist with relocation both with support and financially.
* SSC Space Netherlands contributes 15,4% of pensionable salary to a company pension scheme and employees can optionally make additional contributions.

**To be considered for this Position**
  
Prior to **2026-12-10**, please apply via our **Job Application form.**
  
If not directly interested, feel free to share this Job Vacancy with your friends!
  
  
**Outro**
  
SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
  
  
With local presence on all continents and about 750 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
  
  
We help Earth benefit from space. Learn more at sscspace.com

As a Mechanical Engineer, you’re looking for a role where you can fully express your creativity and problem-solving skills. Ideally, you'd like to do this for an innovative company, one you can be proud of. At Teqram, we’re working on one of the biggest innovations in industrial automation: autonomous vision guided robots.

**Your Key Challenge as a Mechanical Engineer:**

Together with our other mechanical engineers, you will be responsible for quickly developing high-quality, mechatronic systems. We build standardized solutions which are highly configurable to customer specific use-cases. Most of our robots are used in the sheet metal and plate industry, so every solution you create must not only be functional but also robust.

Your work starts with a problem that probably has not been solved before. On top of that there are challenging constraints and demands such as space, form-factor, cost, maintainability and durability.

You will be part of a dynamic, social, and highly intelligent team of professionals who are passionate about what they do. We expect you to have a strong interest in other disciplines such as electrical engineer and software in order to be succesful.

**Your responsibilities include:**

* Developing concept solutions.
* Drafting concepts in Solidworks.
* Improving existing systems.
* Liasing with production for any design questions
* Supervising prototype construction.

**We take on the challenges others didn't dare to, will you?**

We are looking for a pragmatic, inventive, and technically skilled colleague. You design in a way that ensures the robot performs its tasks effectively and consistently. Every design you create has been carefully thought through. You either have experience or a strong affinity with industrial automation, robotics, and/or machinery. You’re an approachable team member, someone who quickly gets to the heart of the matter and isn’t satisfied until you fully understand the problem. During busy periods, you know how to set your priorities. You also enjoy being part of a close-knit team and work well with your colleagues.

**What we expect from you as a Mechanical Engineer:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Automation.
* Proficiency in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written.
* Experience with Solidworks or other 3D software.
* Hands-on technical skills

**Job Requirements:**

We ask a lot, but we offer much more.

Most importantly, you will be contributing to one of the most significant innovations in robotics in recent years. You will also work in an environment where you can apply your experience and ideas. We expect commitment, but we also offer it in return. Together, we strive for continuous improvement, and from day one, your opinions will be valued. Teqram is financially stable, allowing us to invest strategically to maintain and expand our unique position. We ensure that you will find challenges here and, importantly, continue to find them.

**Are you ready to push the boundaries of robotic automation?**

Join Teqram and be part of a team that’s shaping the future!

For more information, feel free to contact Martin Bruins via 06-29113915 or m.bruins@tosec.nl

Bij HTM PSM werk je aan mechanische componenten en assemblages voor veeleisende industrieën zoals lucht- en ruimtevaart, defensie en high-tech productie.

U vertaalt klantvereisten naar praktische technische oplossingen en werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega's om producten te ontwikkelen waar precisie, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid essentieel zijn. Met uitdagende projecten, diverse verantwoordelijkheden en veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën komt uw ontwerp tot leven.

**Over HTM PSM**
----------------

HTM PSM staat voor precisie op het hoogste niveau. Hier produceer je producten met een nauwkeurigheid op micronniveau voor sectoren zoals de luchtvaart en defensie, en bedien je klanten over de hele wereld. Het is een werkomgeving waarin kwaliteit voorop staat, technologie uitdagingen met zich meebrengt en geen enkele dag hetzelfde is.

Met geavanceerde machines, een informele werksfeer en een team waarin jong talent en ervaring elkaar aanvullen, biedt HTM PSM je alle kansen om te leren, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en je verder te ontwikkelen. Een plek waar je elke dag werkt aan slimme technologie en aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

* Voldoende mogelijkheden om te leren en te ontwikkelen

Als werktuigbouwkundige bij HTM PSM zet je klantvereisten om in praktische, hoogwaardige mechanische ontwerpen met behulp van 3D CAD-software. Je maakt technische tekeningen, optimaliseert componenten en assemblages en zorgt ervoor dat je ontwerpen klaar zijn voor productie.

In nauwe samenwerking met collega's uit productie, assemblage, verkoop en kwaliteitscontrole lost u technische uitdagingen op en verbeteren u bestaande ontwerpen. U beheert ook de technische documentatie, ondersteunt de productie en draagt bij aan continue verbetering. Met uw technische expertise en creativiteit helpen u onze klanten innovatieve, betrouwbare en hoogprecise oplossingen te leveren.

* Ervaring met 3D CAD-software, zoals SolidWorks, Inventor of een vergelijkbaar engineering-tool.

* De mogelijkheid om klantvereisten om te zetten in praktische, kostenefficiënte en maakbare oplossingen.
* Sterke technische kennis en probleemoplossend vermogen, met oog voor detail en kwaliteit.
* Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels, en de mogelijkheid om effectief samen te werken met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen.
* Ervaring met ERP-systemen is een voordeel.
* Een proactieve, onafhankelijke en accurate benadering van uw werk.
* De bereidheid om te leren, je technische expertise te ontwikkelen en bij te dragen aan continue verbetering.

### **Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?**

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

#### **The Role**

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

* Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.
* Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product.
* Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible.
* Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records.
* Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development.
* Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability.

* Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.
* Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.
* Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

Vanuit jouw civieltechnische expertise herken je waar onderhoud, vervanging of verbetering nodig is. Je brengt handelingsopties in beeld en weegt technische noodzaak en risico’s af tegen kosten en waarde. Die waarde kan bijvoorbeeld liggen in een langere levensduur, lagere risico- en onderhoudskosten, betere commerciële bruikbaarheid of een sterkere functie in de openbare ruimte.

Samen met collega’s van onder andere Beheer, Infra, Commercie en Finance vertaal je technische bevindingen naar een helder en onderbouwd advies over wat we wanneer met een asset moeten doen. Daarbij werk je aan een uitzonderlijk divers areaal van kades, steigers, bolders, wegen en andere civiele constructies. Sommige constructies zijn al bijna honderd jaar in gebruik, terwijl op andere locaties nieuwe infrastructuur wordt ontworpen en gerealiseerd.

De haven wordt intensief gebruikt voor scheepvaart, overslag en zwaar transport. Je beoordeelt daarom de technische staat, belasting, het gebruik en de verwachte levensduur van constructies. Op basis van tekeningen, inspectieresultaten, berekeningen en technische onderzoeken bepaal je of nader onderzoek, monitoring, onderhoud, versterking, renovatie of vervanging nodig is. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de huidige conditie, maar ook naar toekomstige gebruikseisen en ontwikkelingen in het havengebied.

Technische keuzes staan niet los van hun omgeving. Je houdt daarom ook rekening met bereikbaarheid, commerciële bruikbaarheid, groenstructuren, biodiversiteit en de kwaliteit van de openbare ruimte. Ook de energie- en circulaire transitie stellen nieuwe eisen aan de infrastructuur. Er komen nieuwe assets en technische raakvlakken bij waarvoor nog niet altijd beheerstrategieën, onderhoudsconcepten of standaarden bestaan. Jij helpt ervoor te zorgen dat deze ontwikkelingen vanaf het ontwerp goed aansluiten op de bestaande civiele infrastructuur en gedurende hun volledige levensduur beheersbaar blijven.

Je analyses vormen de basis voor onderhoudsprogramma’s, ontwerpen, renovaties en investeringsbesluiten. Je bent een technisch-inhoudelijke gesprekspartner voor beheerders, projectmanagers, ingenieursbureaus, commercie en de divisie havenmeester. Je werkt nauw samen met RD&I, productie, contractors, leveranciers en andere interne stakeholders. Je schakelt veel tussen afdelingen, brengt mensen bij elkaar en zorgt dat afspraken helder zijn en worden nagekomen.

Dit is een vaste fulltime functie op onze locatie in Deventer. Je rapporteert aan de Manager Technical Services.

**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

**Job's mission**

We are seeking innovative, motivated recent graduates to join our team as Mechanical Engineers. In this role, you will contribute to new product development, sustainment, and engineering design projects. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving challenging problems, is thorough and detail-oriented, and uses experimentation and model-based analysis to identify root causes. You will collaborate effectively with cross-disciplinary teams to solve complex engineering problems and drive new technological advancements.

**What you will be working on**

Responsibilities:

* Design mechanical systems and products supporting ASM process chambers using sound engineering principles
* Interpret and design to gas, water and pneumatic schematics
* Create and manage 3D CAD models (Creo) and 2D drawings with GD&T
* Perform engineering analysis including structural, thermal, and fluid dynamics
* Lead hardware development from concept through testing and HVM readiness
* Participate in design reviews and drive DFx activities
* Collaborate with suppliers to resolve fabrication challenges
* Prepare clear, complete engineering documentation to support prototype builds, manufacturing, and testing.
* Support cost estimation for new features and enhancements
* Maintain product configuration using modern PLM tools

  

Requirements:

* Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or higher
* 0-3 years of experience in mechanical design using 3D CAD (Creo preferred)
* Knowledge of vacuum and thermal systems, gas/fluid delivery, wafer handling
* Understanding of materials: QTZ; SiC; metals, surface coatings and surface finishes.
* Knowledge of GD&T and engineering drawing standards
* Cleanroom experience of deposition technologies (CVD, ALD, EPI, PVD), hand-on assembly and testing experiences are strongly preferred

  

**Apply today to be part of what’s next.**

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Do you enjoy turning technical concepts into smart and manufacturable mechanical designs?

About The Member Company

We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as:

* Technology & Engineering
* Energy & Renewables
* Life sciences & Pharma
* Digital & IT

**About this vacancy**
----------------------

As a Mechanical Designer, you will work on the development of complex mechanical systems, modules and components for the high-tech industry. You translate technical requirements and concepts into detailed mechanical designs that meet demanding requirements regarding accuracy, manufacturability, reliability and costs. You will work in multidisciplinary teams alongside mechanical engineers, system architects, mechatronics engineers, manufacturing specialists and suppliers. Depending on the project, you may work on precision mechanics, complex machine modules, motion systems, vacuum applications or other high-tech equipment. Your work covers different phases of the development process, from concept and detailed design to testing, improvements and release for manufacturing.

**What we expect from you**
---------------------------

You will: - Translate technical requirements and concepts into detailed mechanical designs; - Develop parts, assemblies and machine modules using 3D CAD such as Siemens NX or Creo; - Create and maintain technical drawings and Bills of Materials; - Apply GD&T, functional dimensioning and tolerance analysis; - Select suitable materials and manufacturing processes; - Take manufacturability, assembly, serviceability and costs into account; - Support technical calculations and FEM analyses where required; - Participate in design reviews and contribute to DFMEA and risk assessments; - Support prototype building, testing and design improvements; - Work closely with engineers, suppliers and manufacturing specialists throughout the development process. You combine creativity with a practical engineering mindset. A good design is not only technically correct in CAD, but also manufacturable, reliable and suitable for its application. What we expect from you - A BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Precision Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable technical discipline; - At least 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in mechanical design, preferably within high-tech or machine building; - Experience with 3D CAD, preferably Siemens NX or Creo; - Experience with PLM/PDM environments such as Teamcenter or Windchill is an advantage; - Knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis and technical drawings; - Understanding of manufacturing technologies, materials and production processes; - Knowledge of DFMA, DFMEA and/or FEM is considered an advantage; - Experience with precision mechanics, machine building or mechatronic systems is highly valued; - You have a practical and analytical approach to engineering challenges; - You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary technical environment; - Professional proficiency in English. Dutch is an advantage.

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------

What you can expect from us TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC operates as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur, you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture. Our Employeneurship model includes: - A permanent employment contract, providing stability and security; - Individual profit sharing, giving you transparency and involvement in your own business; - Access to a personal training budget for technical and professional development; - The possibility to work on challenging projects within leading high-tech companies; - Coaching and support in defining and achieving your personal and professional ambitions; - An international network of experienced engineers and technical specialists; - Entrepreneurial freedom combined with the security of employment. #LI-SL2

Dubai (projects across the UAE)

We offer accommodation or an accommodation allowance, company vehicle, fuel & parking, health insurance, annual home-country flight tickets and performance bonuses.

* Manage the installation, replacement and upgrade of AHUs, FAHUs, FCUs, VRF systems, fans, motors and coils.

* Company vehicle, fuel and parking.
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* 30 days of paid annual leave.
* Annual round-trip flight ticket to your home country.
* Yearly performance bonuses of up to four times monthly salary.
* Continuous training and career development.

Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, including a one-hour break. Occasional night or weekend shutdown work is required on retrofit projects.

Apply through Indeed with your updated CV and a short list of HVAC installation or retrofit projects you have handled, including your role on each.
